observations.observation: Headline footprint is smaller than repair-1. English is immediately below; the restored promise sentence now occupies a separate line before the paragraph. All three read as exact.

Workshop name, date/time, venue and fee remain grouped and readable. Time and fee are optically somewhat smaller than the main paragraph; they remain precise and visible at this viewing size.

The large left chair and the neighbors' arm/cloth silhouettes organize an irregular story around a central headline and lower-center paragraph. The unequal chair-working, sewing and repaired-use episodes remain substantial rather than little ornaments on a passive information panel.

One orange patch covers the area of the earlier jagged shirt hole; no separate hole remains in the working shirt. The held shirt and worn result both have a lower-front orange stitched patch. Thread enters the patch near the older neighbor's hand.
